visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white tabby cat is lying inside a multi-tiered cardboard cat house and scratcher. A person's hand enters the frame from the lower right, offering a small orange felt ball to the cat. The cat looks at the ball with wide eyes. (2) The cat grabs the orange ball with its front paws and performs rapid 'bunny kicks' with its hind legs against the cardboard surface. The camera follows the motion closely. (3) The cat stops kicking and lies still for a moment, looking up towards the lens. A text overlay appears. (4) The cat resumes playing with the ball, biting it and rolling on its side within the cardboard structure. (5) The cat stops again, looking tired or disinterested. The hand moves the ball away and then back. (6) The cat lies on its back, clutching the ball to its chest near its face. It eventually stops moving entirely, lying flat on the scratcher with its eyes wide but body still.

(2) High-pitched 'boing' and cartoonish percussion sounds trigger in sync with rhythmic visual movements. (3) A digital 'low battery' beep sounds, followed by an ascending 'charging' chime. (4) A single, deep resonant bell strike rings out with a long decay, creating a temporary atmosphere of calm. (5) Whimsical piano resumes. (6) A technical 'Windows shutdown' jingle plays. (7) Music fades and a female speaker asks questions with a high-pitched, affectionate tone: '累囉? 中年男貓, 這麼快就累啦?'.
